sig: [[["A", "Hello, this is Jenny Lopez from Prime Office Supplies, calling for Mr. Tran at Bluewave Software."], ["A", "I'm calling about your order of office chairs that was delivered yesterday."], ["A", "Unfortunately, our warehouse made a mistake. You ordered twenty black chairs, but we sent you twenty gray ones."], ["A", "I'm very sorry about that."], ["A", "We'll deliver the correct chairs this Thursday morning, between nine and eleven."], ["A", "Our driver will pick up the gray chairs at the same time, so please keep them in their original boxes if possible."], ["A", "Of course, there's no extra charge for this."], ["A", "And to apologize, we'll take fifteen percent off your next order."], ["A", "Could you call me back to confirm that someone will be at the office on Thursday to receive the delivery?"], ["A", "My direct number is 555-0182."], ["A", "Again, sorry for the trouble, and thank you for your patience."]], {"A": "F-US"}]
